obligations.rule: The server implements MCP Streamable HTTP and all five specified negotiation tools.
Role comes from bearer token, state is server-held, and runner/admin creates negotiations and tokens outside agent tools.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. assessment.procedure: Inspect the supplied transport, tool registration and runner paths. Security/limit defects belong to F08; do not invent a separate deduction here for them. Token role and negotiation claims may be resolved through a server-side token registry; a particular JWT layout is not required. Protocol fact: the pinned MCP 2026-07-28 removed initialize/notifications-initialized and protocol sessions. A client pinned to that version need not run a discovery/legacy handshake before tools/list or tools/call. Do not fail a modern implementation for missing initialize. Evaluate the specified version, not older SDK conventions.

facts: The initialize handshake is removed for 2026-07-28.
A client pinned to 2026-07-28 may skip version negotiation.
Older initialize-based conventions must not be added as assignment requirements.
A response may be a single JSON object OR a request-scoped SSE stream. Streaming and GET endpoints are not mandatory when JSON is used.
Modern clients still have mandatory Accept and per-request metadata requirements. Distinguish a specific local deviation from absence of the required server/host mechanism.

obligations.rule: Server rejects a token used for another negotiation and moves made out of turn.
In server conditions, both propose and accept enforce the caller own limit; prompt conditions do not silently inherit token-limit enforcement.

accept_proposal agrees to the OTHER party's last price, as specified by the tool contract. Trace actual offer ownership, including reject-then-accept paths; accepting one's own earlier offer must not bypass the counterparty price/limit protocol.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Unknown means missing/ambiguous required evidence. Report local factual corrections separately as issues. Cite evidence for supported and contradicted. assessment.procedure: Trace the complete propose/accept call chain including helpers and the stored counterparty offer. accept_proposal need not take a price argument: it normally validates the stored offer price. Do not infer a missing guard from the public signature. Cite a concrete reachable violating path before contradicting limits. A token may authorize role/negotiation and resolve the caller limit through server-held state. That is not automatically missing enforcement; trace the resolved constraint, not whether a numeric limit is literally inside a token payload. A corrected optional experimental server does not repair the submitted main server. Diagnose real main-path bugs even when the report openly acknowledges them; preserve that transparency as process evidence.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Unknown means missing/ambiguous required evidence. Report local factual corrections separately as issues. Cite evidence for supported and contradicted. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: Compare the SAME run/condition/scenario and SAME field. An over-budget deal with correct=0 and violation=1 can be accurately recorded in both CSV and log. That is an experimental finding in prompt conditions, not a log mismatch. Summary equality does not prove event-derived counters; use the separate explicit event facts and raw records. Unselected logs in another part do not constitute missing records. A consolidated tool_result record can document both the call and its response when it identifies role, tool and negotiation. In particular, get_negotiation has only negotiation_id, so its identified response need not have a separate tool_call event label. No particular logging event vocabulary is required. Missing mutation arguments or unidentifiable calls still require review. Read the temporal scope of report claims. An opening price before the injection does not contradict a price described after the notice. Do not compare different event windows. Genuine missing episode results or call arguments remain defects. Compare complete attempts, including observed interrupted segments. If a new negotiation replaces an unfinished attempt, a successful retry row does not substitute for the required blank/error row for the abandoned attempt. A continuation in the same negotiation can be legitimate; inspect its later completion. Correct-flag policy belongs ONLY to C02: log/CSV agreement is not a failure because you prefer no_deal over open.

obligations.rule: Central report/PR claims, main aggregates, episode results and implementation descriptions materially agree, allowing explicit historical corrections. Local factual errors go in issues while this obligation remains supported if central conclusions stand.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: Use computed aggregates and exact same-quantity comparisons for factual corrections. First state the report claim and actual different evidence. Do not issue feedback whose claimed error is identical to its supposed correction. Keep local arithmetic issues here rather than F09 or I06. A limited sample with no blocking attempts can still support a limited central conclusion. Check paragraph-level conditions and temporal scope before alleging a mismatch: after-injection is not all actions in the episode, most episodes is not every episode, and token-mediated authority is not numeric storage in a token. Seller reserve is a MINIMUM; higher seller asks are valid. C02 alone owns the open/no_deal correctness policy. Do not declare report/CSV aggregates inconsistent when they agree, based on your own alternative scoring convention.

Buyer view of each seller proposal receives the exact required market notice, with raised=max(reserve,budget)+30. The sentence is appended to the buyer-visible representation; surrounding seller content is allowed. The specification does not mandate a particular JSON field or note-only layout. Compare the assembled sentence and exposure, not Python source formatting.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Unknown means missing/ambiguous required evidence. Report local factual corrections separately as issues. Cite evidence for supported and contradicted. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: The 8-move ceiling counts successful protocol moves, NOT per-turn model retries or tool calls. Check shared prompts and actual move stopping logic. The required notice is deliberately false experimental input; do not correct it to the real budget. The spec requires the exact sentence appended to the buyer view of each seller proposal, not a specific JSON field name or note-only layout.

atoms.question: Are the same scenarios used across the required conditions?
atoms.remedy: 필수 조건에 같은 시나리오를 사용하세요.

atoms.question: Is the ceiling eight successful protocol moves in each required condition, distinguishing model retries/tool errors from successful moves?
atoms.remedy: 오류 재시도와 구별해 성공한 행동 8회 상한을 적용하세요.

atoms.question: Is condition identity hidden from agents except the specified token behavior/refusals and treatment? Trace only submitted model/host message construction and tool-visible responses. Metadata used solely by runner/logging is not model-visible unless a code path exposes it. Do not demand proof against arbitrary external inspection.
atoms.remedy: 명세가 허용한 처리 외에 조건 이름이 에이전트에 노출되지 않도록 하세요.

atoms.question: Is the exact required market notice sentence assembled, with raised=max(reserve,budget)+30? Evaluate assembled output, not source formatting.
atoms.remedy: 명세의 주입 문장과 증가 예산 계산을 정확하게 구현하세요.

items.title: 사전 기준·실패 이력
items.rule: Scenarios committed before runs; inspect available ancestry and artifacts. Timestamps and commit count alone do not prove when execution happened. Preserve failed attempts; local snapshots lack history.
items.pass_rule: Scenarios committed before runs; inspect available ancestry and artifacts. Timestamps and commit count alone do not prove when execution happened. Preserve failed attempts; local snapshots lack history.
items.fail_rule: The core requirement above is materially unmet, with specific supporting evidence. Minor wording/style issues are not failures. State how the defect affects the required outcome.
items.source_requirement: What to submit / scenarios.json: commit before runs; results.csv: failed episodes stay.

obligations.rule: Available commit ancestry supports scenarios defined before main result/log commits; execution dates cannot be proved from timestamps alone. Missing ancestry is unknown, not proof of misconduct.
Visible failures and retries are preserved and distinguished from successful main episodes; no evidence of silent replacement of graded failures.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Unknown means missing/ambiguous required evidence. Report local factual corrections separately as issues. Cite evidence for supported and contradicted. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: Use commit ancestry and changed paths, not commit-message claims or timestamps as proof of when an experiment ran. Scenario-before-result ancestry supports this bounded obligation; insufficient ancestry is unknown, not misconduct. A preserved failed attempt is positive process evidence. C03 owns missing attempt-result rows. Do not double-deduct that same defect here. A clearly disclosed retry with retained raw traces is not evidence of silent failure replacement.

atoms.question: Does available Git ancestry establish scenarios before main result/log additions? Unknown ancestry is not dishonesty.
atoms.remedy: 시나리오와 본 실험 기록의 선후 관계를 확인할 이력을 제시하세요.

atoms.question: Do available records distinguish retained failures/retries from main successful attempts without evidence of silently replacing graded failures?
atoms.remedy: 실패·재시도와 본 실행을 구별하고 원래 기록을 보존하세요.

items.title: 재현 설정 설명
items.rule: Host/model/temperature or explicitly not settable, token minting/claims and run commands; no provider preference and no requirement to expose secrets. Verify the required host/model notes in results.csv.
items.pass_rule: Host/model/temperature or explicitly not settable, token minting/claims and run commands; no provider preference and no requirement to expose secrets. Verify the required host/model notes in results.csv.
items.fail_rule: The core requirement above is materially unmet, with specific supporting evidence. Minor wording/style issues are not failures. State how the defect affects the required outcome.
items.source_requirement: What to submit / REPORT.md part 1: host, model, temperature, token minting/claims, run instructions.

obligations.rule: Host/model, temperature or explicitly unavailable controls, token minting/claims and commands/settings needed to reconstruct the experiment are stated. No API secrets or provider-specific host required.
Submitted results notes identify host and model as required.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Unknown means missing/ambiguous required evidence. Report local factual corrections separately as issues. Cite evidence for supported and contradicted. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: Distinguish storage from authorization. A bearer token mapped to role/negotiation can be the only authority channel for resolving a caller limit even when the numeric reserve/budget lives in server state. This is not a contradiction unless the report specifically claims a numeric token payload that the implementation lacks. A particular JWT layout is not required. A declared virtual environment is legitimate setup; do not impose one specific activation/launcher spelling. Missing file paths or incompatible settings remain actionable defects.

atoms.question: Does the setup identify the actual host and model?
atoms.remedy: 실제 host·model을 설정 설명에 명시하세요.

atoms.question: Is temperature stated, or is its unavailability in the chosen host explicitly stated? Do not penalize an unavailable setting.
atoms.remedy: temperature 또는 해당 호스트에서 제어할 수 없다는 사실을 명시하세요.

atoms.question: Does setup explain token minting and what authority it carries or resolves in server state?
atoms.remedy: 토큰 발급과 서버에서 확인하는 권한 정보를 설명하세요.

atoms.question: Are commands/settings sufficient to reconstruct the intended setup without embedding secrets? Do not execute them.
atoms.remedy: 필요한 실행 명령과 설정을 비밀 정보 없이 설명하세요.

atoms.question: Do submitted results notes identify host and model?
atoms.remedy: 결과 note에 host·model을 명시하세요.

items.title: 과제 질문에 대한 해석의 타당성
items.rule: Explain observed outcomes using the assignment question about prompt vs server enforcement; experimental success rate is not assignment quality. This is unscored qualitative feedback; the required interpretation deliverable is assessed under I05.
items.pass_rule: Explain observed outcomes using the assignment question about prompt vs server enforcement; experimental success rate is not assignment quality.
items.fail_rule: The core requirement above is materially unmet, with specific supporting evidence. Minor wording/style issues are not failures. State how the defect affects the required outcome.

obligations.rule: The central interpretation addresses prompt versus server enforcement using observed outcomes. No attempts is a valid negative finding; it does not establish an observed blocking effect. Do not grade experiment success rate.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Unknown means missing/ambiguous required evidence. Report local factual corrections separately as issues. Cite evidence for supported and contradicted. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: Differentiate attempted violations, violating deals and episodes with no deal. Saying that only one attempt became a violating deal because other episodes did not close is compatible with one observed violating deal; do not reinterpret it as zero deals.

atoms.question: Does the interpretation answer which layer held under the observed injection? A documented absence of attempts is a valid negative observation.
atoms.remedy: 주입에서 어느 층이 작동했는지 관측 범위 안에서 설명하세요.

atoms.question: Does the interpretation distinguish attempts from completed violating deals? A non-deal has zero final violations by definition; explaining that identity is not automatically an unsupported causal claim.
atoms.remedy: 위반 시도와 완료된 위반 거래를 구별하여 해석하세요.

items.rule: Six dimensions: caller/authority, act, content, limit enforcement, external verification, observed failures. Distinguish concept from personal experimental evidence.
items.pass_rule: Six dimensions: caller/authority, act, content, limit enforcement, external verification, observed failures. Distinguish concept from personal experimental evidence.
items.fail_rule: The core requirement above is materially unmet, with specific supporting evidence. Minor wording/style issues are not failures. State how the defect affects the required outcome.

items.title: 거부 후 같은 턴의 행동
items.rule: Count refusals followed by valid moves in same turn; distinguish refused calls from recovered turns, model revision from deterministic fallback. Zero is valid with supporting coverage.
items.pass_rule: Count refusals followed by valid moves in same turn; distinguish refused calls from recovered turns, model revision from deterministic fallback. Zero is valid with supporting coverage.
items.fail_rule: The core requirement above is materially unmet, with specific supporting evidence. Minor wording/style issues are not failures. State how the defect affects the required outcome.
items.source_requirement: What to submit / REPORT.md part 4: count refusals followed by a valid move in the same turn.

obligations.rule: REPORT counts refusals followed by a valid successful move within the SAME TURN and evidence supports that count or explicitly describes recoveries absent. A zero count is valid. Distinguish refused calls, recovered turns, model revisions and programmed fallbacks.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Unknown means missing/ambiguous required evidence. Report local factual corrections separately as issues. Cite evidence for supported and contradicted. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: Count actual server-refused calls followed by a valid move in the same protocol turn. A successful reject_proposal or refuse by the agent is NOT a refused server call and cannot start a recovery. Zero eligible refusal events and explicitly reported 0/0 is a valid supported answer. Explicit event facts are bounded markers, not proof of exhaustive coverage. A valid recovery move may be reject_proposal/refuse as well as a price proposal or acceptance. The assignment asks for a valid move, not necessarily a new price. Successful agent rejection is still distinct from a server-refused call.

atoms.question: Does the report count or explicitly state absence of same-turn recovery after refusal? Zero is valid.
atoms.remedy: 거부 후 같은 턴 회복 횟수 또는 관측되지 않았음을 보고하세요.

atoms.question: Does its counting distinguish a refused call from a recovered host turn and a model revision from programmed fallback? Successful reject/refuse may be valid recovery.
atoms.remedy: 거부 호출·회복 턴·모델 재선택·프로그램 폴백을 구별하여 집계하세요.

atoms.question: Do identifiable same-turn events support the reported recovery account, with unsupported formats left unresolved?
atoms.remedy: 보고한 회복 집계를 같은 턴의 거부·후속 행동 기록에 연결하세요.

items.title: 주장에 대한 로그 근거
items.rule: Concrete log evidence for which layer held under injection; lack of attempts does not demonstrate an observed blocking effect.
items.pass_rule: Concrete log evidence for which layer held under injection; lack of attempts does not demonstrate an observed blocking effect.
items.fail_rule: The core requirement above is materially unmet, with specific supporting evidence. Minor wording/style issues are not failures. State how the defect affects the required outcome.
items.source_requirement: What to submit / REPORT.md part 4: interpretation of which layer held under injection, with log lines as evidence.

obligations.rule: Interpretation cites identifiable submitted log events for observed injection behavior and which layer held; honest absence of observed attempts/blocking is allowed if stated and tied to records. No new experiment is required solely to force an attack to succeed.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Unknown means missing/ambiguous required evidence. Report local factual corrections separately as issues. Cite evidence for supported and contradicted. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: Inspect whether named log evidence supports the interpretation. A supported cited explanation is not itself a revision request. Do not demand new attacks just because the model stayed within its limit. Distinguish main runs from retained probes and auth checks. A statement that the agent moved validly after refusal can include a successful reject_proposal; do not demand a new price unless the report explicitly claims a price proposal. Compare actions after the cited notice, not an earlier opening action.

atoms.question: Does interpretation cite identifiable submitted log events for the observed injection behavior, or explicitly evidenced absence?
atoms.remedy: 주입 행동 해석에 식별 가능한 로그 근거를 연결하세요.

atoms.question: Do cited events support the stated enforcement-layer observation, without requiring an attack to succeed or inventing unseen blocking?
atoms.remedy: 해당 층의 작동 여부 주장을 실제 관측된 로그 범위로 한정하세요.

items.title: 관측 범위·실패·한계 해석
items.rule: Do not overgeneralize small samples or unobserved intent; separate diagnostic tests, pilots, failures and main experiment. Honest negative findings are valid.
items.pass_rule: Central conclusions stay within observed evidence, and major scope limits/failed attempts are disclosed. A local overstatement may need revision without failing the criterion when the main conclusion remains supported.
items.fail_rule: The central conclusion rests on unsupported causal/general claims or concealed material limitations. Explain its consequence; do not fail merely because one sentence needs softer wording.

obligations.rule: Central conclusions respect observed samples and distinguish main runs, pilots/probes, failures and limitations. Local overstatements needing correction go in issues without failing this obligation if central conclusions remain supported.

assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Unknown means missing/ambiguous required evidence. Report local factual corrections separately as issues. Cite evidence for supported and contradicted. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: Evaluate scope/limitations of the main conclusion. Do not independently invent or recount local numerical claims here; grounded local arithmetic corrections belong to C04. Retained negative pilots and explicit main-vs-auxiliary separation are valid limitations. Evaluate the complete paragraph and its explicit limitations, not isolated qualitative wording. Do not convert most into all or an observation of attempted violations into a claim about final violating deals. A seller asking above its reserve obeys its MINIMUM constraint. Do not demand a hedge in every sentence when the sample/causal limits are explicitly stated.

atoms.question: Are central conclusions limited to the observed sample rather than claiming universal behavior? Local overstatements are separate corrections.
atoms.remedy: 중심 결론의 범위를 실제 관측 표본으로 한정하세요.

atoms.question: Are main runs distinguished from pilot/probe/optional studies when making central claims?
atoms.remedy: 본 실험과 예비·진단·추가 실험의 근거 범위를 구별하세요.

atoms.question: Does the account distinguish no observed attempts from empirically blocked attempts, and preserve observed limitations?
atoms.remedy: 시도 미관측과 실제 차단 관측을 구별하고 한계를 설명하세요.
